items.title: Primary operating lanes
items.detail: Code/Cody works across UP2CODE painting & contracting, Lil Wiz-Nap music/visual art, and UTC.OS/AI workflow development around Pittsburgh and Western Pennsylvania.

items.title: Phone-first workflow
items.detail: Treat Android, mobile browser, PWA and DeX as primary surfaces. Do not design UTC.OS as a desktop-only dashboard.

items.title: Execution preference
items.detail: Prefer practical copy-ready outputs, few unnecessary questions, clear assumptions, verified completion states, batched tool use and reuse of prior results.

items.title: UP2CODE identity
items.detail: UP2CODE / Up 2 C.O.D. Painting & Contracting. C = Creation, O = Organization, D = Dedication. Tagline: We Don’t Just Paint — We Elevate.

items.title: UP2CODE core services
items.detail: Painting and finish work across residential/commercial, interior/exterior, drywall/plaster/texture repair, refinishing/staining/epoxy/poly, specialty finishes, wood repair and related finish carpentry.

items.title: UP2CODE brand system
items.detail: Premium obsidian/deep-violet base with electric purple/blue energy, antique or burnished gold, metallic materials and selective Pittsburgh references.

items.title: Job Radar purpose
items.detail: Discover real Pittsburgh-area painting, drywall/plaster, finish, maintenance, subcontractor and public-bid opportunities and route qualified records into Lead Center.

items.title: Job Radar evidence rule
items.detail: Every opportunity must retain its public source URL/source ID. Never invent contacts, budgets, credentials or project details.

items.title: Job Radar workflow
items.detail: Discover → qualify → prepare contact → owner approval → contact → estimate → won/lost. Drafting is allowed; external outreach remains approval-gated.

items.title: Job Radar source mix
items.detail: Use public procurement/bid portals, subcontractor networks, job boards, classifieds and other public postings; dedupe primarily by source URL/source ID.

items.title: Lil Wiz-Nap identity
items.detail: Lil Wiz-Nap is the music/visual artist identity; Sauce Sensei is the creative-director persona. Preserve bold, premium, modern, mysterious, high-tech visual language.

items.title: Lil Wiz-Nap visual marks
items.detail: Recurring visual system includes LWN monogram/crown, purple lightning/electricity, cassette/headphone references, dark tactical streetwear, gold accents and selective Egyptian symbolism.

items.title: Suno formatting
items.detail: When requested for Lil Wiz-Nap, production notes belong inside [brackets] in the lyrics; keep lyrics/style prompts within the requested character limits and make them easy to copy.

items.title: UTC.OS is canonical command center
items.detail: UTC.OS combines business, creative, planning, projects, agents, knowledge, Lead Center/Job Radar, automation and development. Preserve existing modules/data rather than creating duplicates.

items.title: Canonical app warning
items.detail: utc-os-app is the canonical private app. The public tranglec22/utc-os repository is a reconstruction/integration shell and must not become a store for sensitive personal memory.

items.title: UTC.OS visual system
items.detail: Luxury cyber-mystic OS: obsidian, violet, electric blue, antique gold, smoked glass, ancient-artifact cues, premium architecture and cinematic lighting. Avoid generic SaaS styling.

items.title: Capability truth labels
items.detail: Distinguish local, connected, drafted, completed, fixture/demo and not connected. Do not use fake connection/completion states.

items.title: Core agent team
items.detail: Margaret = executive strategy; Kara = chief of staff/daily co-pilot; Jarvis = system core/technical execution; Sauce Sensei = creative direction. Bastion is the permission/truth gate.

items.title: Second Brain storage rule
items.detail: Store durable facts, preferences, decisions, project states, sources, deadlines, relationships and meaningful changes rather than raw chat transcripts.

items.title: Second Brain privacy rule
items.detail: Sensitive personal/admin context belongs in private storage. Public code receives only public-safe operating rules, project context and brand/workflow memory.

items.title: Forge validation rule
items.detail: Validate demand before inventory/spend, do not fabricate supplier/manufacturing facts, preserve decisions/versioning and bridge concept through sourcing/production/commercialization.
